subtitle: Out Manila · Cathay Pacific Airlines
overview: Fly Cathay Pacific via Hong Kong to Qingdao for four nights in 5-star hotels. See Zhanqiao Pier, St. Michael’s Cathedral, the Badaguan Scenic Area and the World Horticultural Expo, enjoy snow fun at a ski resort (late December to February), and dine on hot pot buffet and seafood barbecue. This is a No Shopping package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Jan 7–11 2027 to Feb 24–28 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Hong Kong – Qingdao
items: Fly Manila to Hong Kong (CX976, 05:45–08:10), then Hong Kong to Qingdao (CX954, 10:05–13:15)
Meet the tour guide at the airport
Bright Moon & Mountains-Sea Sleepless City, with street performances such as “Mountains and Seas Under the Bright Moon” and interaction with NPC actors
Transfer to hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Qingdao
items: Qingdao City Memory Hall (time-travel bus tour through a century of Qingdao)
Tsingtao Beer Museum, with 1 cup of freshly brewed pure draft beer, 1 cup of draft beer and 1 pack of beer snacks (optional)

itinerary.title: Qingdao
items: Sea-crossing bridge and Tangdao Bay Park
Yuejishan or Zangmashan Ski Resort – snow fun (late December to February)

itinerary.title: Qingdao
items: World Horticultural Exposition, with small train to view the Metasequoia Avenue and Pine Forest
Seafood barbecue buffet dinner (one Jiaodong sea cucumber per person)

itinerary.title: Qingdao – Hong Kong – Manila
items: Transfer to the airport and fly Qingdao to Hong Kong (CX951, 14:30–18:15)
Connecting flight Hong Kong to Manila (CX913, 20:20–22:35)

placeDesc.National Wetland Park: A wetland park in Qingdao, visited on the afternoon of arrival.
placeDesc.Confucius Statue: A statue of Confucius at the Qingdao wetland park area, a stop on the first-day city sights.
placeDesc.Sundial Square: A public square in Qingdao with a large sundial feature, visited on the first-day city tour.
placeDesc.Zhanqiao Pier: Qingdao's century-old pier extending into Jiaozhou Bay, the city's best-known landmark.
placeDesc.St. Michael’s Cathedral: A twin-spired Catholic cathedral in Qingdao's old town, seen from the outside on this tour.
placeDesc.Liyuan Leisure Block: A restored leisure and shopping block in Qingdao's old city area.
placeDesc.Qingdao City Memory Hall: A Qingdao museum-style attraction where a time-travel bus tour recalls a century of the city.
placeDesc.Taidong Pedestrian Street: A busy pedestrian shopping and street-food district in Qingdao.
placeDesc.Tangdao Bay Park: A seaside park on Tangdao Bay, reached by crossing the sea-crossing bridge.
placeDesc.Yuejishan Ski Resort: A ski resort near Qingdao used for snow fun in the winter season (late December to February).
placeDesc.Zangmashan Ski Resort: A ski resort near Qingdao used for snow fun in the winter season (late December to February).
placeDesc.University Road: A Qingdao street known for a popular wall used for photos, near the university area.
placeDesc.World Horticultural Exposition: Qingdao's World Horticultural Expo park; a small train tours the Metasequoia Avenue and pine forest.
placeDesc.Badaguan Scenic Area: A Qingdao district of tree-lined streets and historic villas in various European styles.
placeDesc.May Fourth Square: A waterfront square in Qingdao, known for the red 'May Wind' sculpture.
placeDesc.Olympic Sailing Center: The Qingdao marina built for the 2008 Olympic sailing events.
placeDesc.Lovers’ Dam: A seaside breakwater promenade in Qingdao, a popular spot for photos along the coast.
placeDesc.Tsingtao Beer Museum: A museum at the Tsingtao brewery site; the optional tour includes tastings of draft beer.
placeDesc.Governor’s Mansion: A historic residence in Qingdao's old town from the German colonial period, offered as an optional visit.
